THE DAIGO CHALLENGE

Make the comeback.

You’re Ken, on the right, with one health point. Parry all fifteen kicks from Chun-Li’s super, then knock her out. Blocking deals chip damage and will end your attempt.

  1. Tap forward. Release. Repeat.

    Tap ← toward Chun-Li just before each hit. Release between taps; holding forward won’t keep parrying.

  2. Take the last one airborne.

    Jump before the final kick, then tap forward in the air to parry it.

  3. Finish the comeback.

    Jumping heavy kick → crouching medium kick → Shippu Jinraikyaku. For the super, input ↓ ↙ ← ↓ ↙ ← + kick.

Browser port source · AGPL-3.0

Each fresh forward tap has a ten-frame parry window, including the first and airborne parries. Release between taps; holding forward does not parry the next hit.
Assistance places each parry symbol near the middle of that window. Its shaded band shows the full valid window and the dimmed target glows while it is open. For the counterattack, hold tails show how long to keep a direction. Follow the jump and counterattack cues. The guide follows game frames and freezes on pause or a missed sequence. If movement changes the hit rhythm, retry to realign the guide.
Game and Evo adjust their audio independently; 0% mutes a track. The Evo recording starts with Chun-Li’s super and stops on a failed parry or an escape. Complete all fifteen parries to keep it playing.
Opening Help pauses an active attempt. Closing it returns you to the game.
